notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes - Bonnie's Bakery Patch Notes 4/11/2024
notes.content:
Hello all!

SoupDev squashed some small bugs that slipped through the cracks:
- Dragging the cake tin to the Red Velvet batter would cause issues (and deny your customers their delicious cake).
- Exiting the Bistro in the Dog Investigation level without listening in on the Dog and Squirrel's conversation and then re-entering the Bistro would cause the Squirrel to disappear.

Cheers,
- FishDev

notes.title: Save File Hotfix 2 - Bonnie's Bakery Patch Notes 12/18/2023
notes.content:
Hello all!

Looks like our last save file hotfix still had a few holes in it! We've improved the save system code to hopefully squash the last few pesky bugs that were causing issues.
If you've been getting stuck after finishing Baking Mode for the first time, this should (hopefully!) allow you to progress to the next level.

If you're still having issues after this hotfix, please reach out to us!

We've also fixed some of the battle tutorial text in The Ethereal Lady skipping, which was making it hard to read. 

Sorry for any inconveniences this has caused. Here's to a smoother experience moving forward!
- FishDev

notes.title: The Final Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello hello everyone!

The Final Update is finally here! Thank you all so much for your patience this past month as we've been polishing and bugtesting this final build! ​​​As you all may have seen from the trailer, this update brings two new game modes to Bonnie's Bakery! In this update, you can find:

[olist]
[*]     [b]The Ethereal Lady Book[/b]​ - Oh my! Someone didn't put this book away​! Maybe you should give it a read? Play as the Ethereal Lady as you go through her story chapter by chapter! ​Protect your children from the horrible beasts that are running rampant with a real-time, turn-based combat system! 
[*]     [b]​Endless Bonking Mode[/b] - Bonk every ingredient with reckless abandon! See how high your score can go before the police are called! ​​​​Stack upgrades and become the ultimate bonking machine as you rampage through the twisted city! 
[/olist]

We've been hard at work to make this update the best it can be, and we're very excited to show you all the culmination of these last few weeks! Along with the new content, we've also fixed some minor bugs and boosted the performance of the game! 

In addition, the Steam version of the game now has Cloud Save enabled, so you can continue your baking and bonking on any computer! 

Now, you may be wondering why this is the last update we're making to Bonnie's Bakery. After working on the base game and DLC for the past year and a half, the project has grown a lot! Since the original game was made for a game jam, the base game wasn't really built with​​​​ this much expansion in mind, so the project files have become pretty unruly! We are definitely planning to ​expand on the world of Bonnie's Bakery, but we plan to do so in the form of other projects, rather than continuing to work off of the base game! ​

That being said, we're going to go into preproduction for our next project over the course of the next few months! We've actually been hinting at it ever since the addition of the Fresh Ingredients DLC! Can you guess what it is? 👀

As always, we really appreciate all of your support​​! We hope you enjoy the final update to Bonnie's Bakery! 

- SoupDev​​

notes.title: Save File Hotfix - Bonnie's Bakery Patch Notes 7/22/2023
notes.content:
Hello all!

This update fixes a problem with the save system that was causing issues for Steam users with certain characters in their usernames.
Save files use a slightly different format now which should be free of this error.
If your game was breaking after completing Baking Mode, you should now be able to progress to the next level.

We also fixed a small bug with the 'Perfectionist' achievement that caused it to sometimes trigger incorrectly.

Thanks for bearing with us!
- FishDev
